name: Williams %R(14) cross of -60/-40 band with SMA200 filter and pip TP/SL
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Forex-style pip inputs; rescale for crypto.
entry_long: Long when Williams %R(14) crosses above -60 (= -50 - crossPips 10) and close > SMA(200).
entry_short: Short when %R crosses below -40 (= -50 + 10) and close < SMA(200).
exit: Exit at +30 pips take profit or -20 pips stop (close-based test).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
implementation_notes: Pip thresholds are syminfo.mintick-based; the %R crossPips is applied directly to the -50 line.
